title: Syntactic Complexity Convergence in Dialogue: Analysis of the Phenomenon and Application to LLM Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.18606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We revisit the under-explored phenomenon of syntactic complexity convergence in dialogue. Extending prior topic-level analyses to full conversations, we examine five human-human datasets and a set of human-LLM dialogues. We integrate and evaluate a multidimensional set of syntactic complexity metrics to quantify structural variation in dialogue. Our analyses reveal robust syntactic complexity convergence across human-human datasets, especially in task-oriented interactions, and statistical tests confirm that these effects are not due to chance. In contrast, human-LLM dialogues show no significant convergence under individual metrics; however, linear-CKA uncovers a distinct cross-metric convergence pattern. Motivated by these differences, we use syntactic complexity as a feature for detecting LLM-involved dialogue, achieving 96\% accuracy. translated_title: 对话中的句法复杂性趋同：现象分析及其在大语言模型检测中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了对话中句法复杂性趋同这一尚未被充分探索的现象。我们将先前基于话题层面的分析扩展到完整对话，考察了五个人类-人类数据集以及一组人类-大语言模型对话。我们整合并评估了多维度的句法复杂性指标，以量化对话中的结构变化。我们的分析揭示了人类-人类数据集中稳健的句法复杂性趋同现象，尤其在任务导向型交互中表现明显，统计检验证实这些效应并非偶然。相比之下，人类-大语言模型对话在单个指标下未表现出显著趋同；然而，linear-CKA 揭示了一种独特的跨指标趋同模式。受这些差异的启发，我们将句法复杂性作为检测涉及大语言模型对话的特征，达到了96%的准确率。我们的分类结果展示了这一方法的潜力，且无需依赖基于似然的信号。
tldr: 本研究将句法复杂性趋同现象的分析扩展到完整对话层面，发现人类对话中存在稳健的句法趋同而人机对话呈现独特的跨指标模式，并据此利用句法复杂性特征实现了96%准确率的大语言模型对话检测。
en_tdlr: This study extends the analysis of syntactic complexity convergence to full conversations, revealing robust convergence in human-human dialogues but a distinct cross-metric pattern in human-LLM dialogues, and leverages syntactic complexity features to detect LLM-involved dialogue with 96% accuracy.
